dedupe_keys.name: dominican republic active schools with enrolment school period 2022 2024 minerd

description: Ministerio de Educación (MINERD), Dominican Republic publishes the list of active schools for the 2022 to 2024 school period, public, private and semi-official, with enrolment and classification by education level, surveyed by the Ministry of Education. Coverage: the Dominican Republic nationwide; school period 2022-2024, updated annually, record last modified on 2025-04-02. Format and access: XLSX, ODS, CSV, downloadable without registration from the Dominican open data portal (datos.gob.do); the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL); cost: free. Caveats: the files were not opened, so whether school coordinates are included is unconfirmed; it is a school census list, not a building or condition inventory. Simulation uses: school locations and enrolment for shelter-capacity, evacuation and service-accessibility analyses. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
